info.title: Daktar Kothay API
info.description: Backend API for finding specialist doctors and chambers in Bangladesh

get.summary: View own user profile and saved location
get.description: Returns the authenticated patient's profile information and saved GPS location coordinates.

patch.summary: Update or save own user location
patch.description: Upserts the authenticated user's GPS coordinates and area information in their profile. Used as fallback location during doctor searches.

get.summary: Search verified doctors and chambers sorted by distance
get.description: Core search feature. Resolves coordinates via GPS (lat/lng), area name, or saved user profile. Public endpoint that accepts an optional bearer token to use saved user coordinates.

parameters.name: specialtyId
parameters.description: Direct specialty UUID filter (overrides disease specialty)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match on doctor name

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Search origin latitude (must be sent together with lng)

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Search origin longitude (must be sent together with lat)

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Maximum search radius in kilometers (default 5 km, max 50 km)

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Filter chambers open on this weekday

nameAndFeeSearch.summary: Example 2 - Name, area and fee filter

400.description: Validation failed (missing location, radius > 50, lat without lng)

get.summary: View own doctor profile, chambers, and completion status
get.description: Returns the authenticated doctor's profile, qualifications, all chambers (active and inactive), and profile completion status.

data.name: Dr. Demo Verified
data.bio: Experienced Dermatologist providing comprehensive skin care and allergy treatment.

patch.description: Updates bio, degrees, years of experience, or specialty for the logged-in doctor. At least one field is required.

bio.example: Updated bio with expanded clinic consultation details.

example.bio: Updated bio with expanded clinic consultation details.

data.name: Dr. Demo Verified
data.bio: Updated bio with expanded clinic consultation details.

404.description: Specialty or doctor profile not found

get.summary: View public details and active chambers of a verified doctor
get.description: Public endpoint returning verified doctor profile info and active visiting chambers with schedules. Only returns doctors who have been verified by an admin.

data.name: Dr. Demo Verified
data.bio: Experienced Dermatologist providing comprehensive skin care and allergy treatment.

404.description: Doctor not found or not verified

get.summary: Autocomplete diseases by name or aliases
get.description: Public endpoint for fast disease autocomplete search matching both disease names and medical/common Bengali aliases.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query matched against disease names and aliases (minimum 2 characters)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of diseases to return (1 to 20, default 10)

400.description: Validation failed (missing or too short query)

get.description: Public endpoint returning the list of all registered medical specialties ordered alphabetically.

get.summary: List all chambers with schedules for the logged-in doctor
get.description: Returns all visiting chambers (active and inactive) registered under the authenticated doctor account, with weekly consultation hours.

post.summary: Add a new chamber with visiting schedules
post.description: Registers a new visiting chamber and weekly visiting schedule slots for the authenticated doctor.

400.description: Validation failed (invalid time, duplicate weekday, bad coordinates)

patch.summary: Update own chamber details (replaces all schedules if provided)
patch.description: Modifies chamber information (fee, contact number, active status) and atomically updates visiting schedules.

delete.summary: Delete own chamber and all associated schedules
delete.description: Deletes a visiting chamber owned by the logged-in doctor, along with all of its schedule rows.

post.description: Creates a user account with role USER and optional initial location profile.

400.description: Validation failed (missing required fields, bad formats, or mismatched lat/lng)

409.description: Email or phone already in use

post.summary: Register a new doctor (pending admin verification)
post.description: Registers a new doctor account with role DOCTOR and status PENDING. Doctor must be approved by admin before appearing in search results.

201.description: Doctor registered. Waiting for admin approval

example.message: Doctor registered. Waiting for admin approval

409.description: Email, phone, or BMDC number already in use

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description: Authenticates any registered user (patient, doctor, or admin) and returns a signed JWT. Use the example dropdown to quickly try seeded demo accounts.

get.summary: List doctors filtered by approval status
get.description: Administrative endpoint to list doctors by their status (PENDING, VERIFIED, REJECTED), ordered newest first, with their chamber count.

post.summary: Add a verified doctor directly with optional chambers and schedules
post.description: Administrative endpoint to onboard a doctor directly with VERIFIED status and initial chambers in a single transaction.

example.bio: Skin specialist with 8 years of experience.

409.description: Email, phone, or BMDC number already exists

patch.description: Administrative endpoint to verify a pending doctor. Sets their status to VERIFIED so they can appear in search once they have active chambers.
Administrative endpoint to reject a doctor. Sets status to REJECTED, immediately hiding them from public search and doctor details.
